gates.requirement: Every applicable versioned public mutation assertion must pass without changing the frozen suite.
gates.observed: 339/339 assertions passed across 66 candidate and 22 fallback cases.
gates.rationale: The exact aggregate suite passed; out-of-policy SQL and Python cases retained the named seed fallback.

gates.requirement: Canonical candidate estimates must be byte-identical in fresh Windows, Linux, and macOS processes.
gates.observed: 3 platforms x 3 saved-evidence shapes; evidence identical=True; seed bytes identical=True; candidate bytes identical=True; LF-normalized candidate bytes identical=True; repeated outputs identical=True.
gates.rationale: All repeated and cross-platform canonical projection bytes matched.

gates.requirement: Each shape/platform candidate median must be at most max(seed x 1.15, seed + 250 ms).
gates.rationale: Every platform-shape pair remains within the frozen overhead boundary.

gates.requirement: Each shape/platform candidate slowest run must be at most max(seed x 1.25, seed + 500 ms).
gates.rationale: Every platform-shape pair remains within the frozen overhead boundary.

gates.requirement: Each shape/platform candidate peak must be at most max(seed x 1.15, seed + 64 MiB).
gates.rationale: Every platform-shape pair remains within the frozen overhead boundary.

gates.requirement: The staged installed candidate tool may add at most 25 MiB over the seed tool.
gates.observed: Seed 39655495 bytes; candidate 40690538 bytes; increase 0.9871 MiB; limit 25 MiB.
gates.rationale: The installed candidate model/runtime overlay remains within the frozen package limit.

gates.requirement: Whole-command scanner checks must retain applicable thresholds and unchanged target fingerprints.
gates.observed: linux=99604 lines/1.859s/105.77MiB/unchanged:True; macos=99604 lines/1.477s/101.88MiB/unchanged:True; windows=99604 lines/2.255s/79.47MiB/unchanged:True
gates.rationale: All three static mixed scans retained target fingerprints and offline/non-executing signals; no frozen cross-platform scanner threshold applies.

limitations: Latency and memory are paired engineering measurements on GitHub-hosted runners, not universal product guarantees.
Saved-evidence shapes are deterministic synthetic scaling inputs; they do not establish population accuracy.
The installed candidate layout conservatively stages the complete calibration assembly plus the exact model artifact; an admitted product integration may be smaller.
No cross-platform scanner latency or memory threshold is frozen; the scanner gate checks its applicable process, offline, and unchanged-target boundaries.
